outOfScope: CartController calls setAllowRefresh(false), but the kit path of CommonController::renderKpiRowAction ignores it: every visit fetches AdminStats getKpi for a total the server already rendered. Pass refreshUrl only when allowRefresh is true.
Because of that refetch, an employee who can view AdminCarts but not AdminStats always sees a dash for the cart total.
Give CartNotFoundException its own translation key instead of the generic 'The object cannot be loaded (or found).' shared by about 40 files.
